summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of forthcoming results, its equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K. The UK-based medical technology registrant stated it will release its third-quarter 2026 trading report, for the period ended 26 September 2026, on Wednesday 4 November 2026 at 7:00am GMT, followed by an analyst conference call at 12:00pm GMT. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural or regulatory terms were disclosed. This is a routine scheduling announcement; no risk-arbitrage angle applies.
